tenderSchedule.title: Comprehensive Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) of PCs and Peripherals
tenderSchedule.description: Comprehensive Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) of PCs and Peripherals located at Bengaluru based offices for a contract period of three years
tenderSchedule.locationName: KPCL Superintending Engineer S and K office Bengaluru

tenderAddress.blockNumber: Superintending Engineer-Systems and KERP,Karnataka Power Corporation Limited, 4th floor, KPCL Green Building, No.3, Palace Road

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder shall have successfully executed at least one similar order in State/Central/PSU of value of not less than Rs24.17 lakh in a single order, for Annual Maintenance Contract Desktops and Peripherals during last five financial years i.e. 2021-22 to 2025-26. The bidders shall upload one single order copy with order value not less than Rs 24.17 lakh for Annual Maintenance Contract of Desktops and Peripherals and shall be completed before bid notification date.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Bidders shall upload Relevant document.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder shall upload satisfactory contract completion certificate corresponding to above order signed by the head of the department or competent authority and contract should have been completed before bid notification date.

Bidder shall have an average annual turnover of not less than Rs 48.35 lakh in any two financial years during the previous five financial years (i.e. 2021-22 to 2025-26). Bidder shall upload the copies of Annual turnover and Profit and Loss account statements duly certified by the Chartered Accountant. The bidders shall upload annual financial turnover certificate mentioning UDIN (Unique Document Identification Number) duly signed by Chartered accountant in this regard.
